exposure: timing of federal sterilization consent signing
day of the week of delivery
patient changing mind related to procedural issues
outcome: receipt of postpartum permanent contraception procedure
cohort: The study included 189 women who requested postpartum permanent contraception after vaginal delivery at Strong Memorial Hospital in Rochester, NY.
finding: Fewer than half of women obtained desired postpartum permanent contraception after vaginal delivery, with logistical issues and obesity identified as the most common reported barriers.
